concerns.text: Task T015 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but its body deletes `data/processed/`, `models/`, and `results/` directories and then re‑executes the entire pipeline. Running this task in parallel with any other task would corrupt or erase shared artifacts, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the task moved to the very end of the plan where no other tasks are concurrent.
